fusions.name: Handed Along
fusions.desc: Lobs a brick to a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Steady Round
fusions.desc: Sweeps the trowel round in one steady stroke, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Many Hands
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control effects from you and your allies.

fusions.name: Mason's Mitts
fusions.desc: Conjures a mason's gloves: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical damage by 15% and your maximum health by 12, and each kill restores 3 health.
